The '''X4-Z2 Battle Droid''' was a model of three-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Exchange]] criminal organization on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Exchange used a number of X4-Z2 droids to patrol the [[Coronet Boulevard]] of the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The X4-Z2 Battle Droid appeared on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
